info.name: HPE OmniStack REST backups external_stores API

params.name: name
params.description:
The name of the external_stores to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: omnistack_cluster_id
params.description: The identifier of the cluster. This identifier is unique within the category namespace.

params.name: management_ip
params.description:
The IP address of the external store

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: cluster_group_id
params.description:
The unique identifiers (UIDs) of the cluster_groups associated with the external stores to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: fields
params.description:
A comma-separated list of fields to include in the returned objects

 Default: Returns all fields

params.name: limit
params.description:
A positive integer that represents the maximum number of results to return

Default: 500

params.name: offset
params.description:
A positive integer that directs the service to start returning the <offset value> instance, up to the limit

Default: 0

params.name: case
params.description:
An indicator that specifies if the filter and sort results use a case-sensitive or insensitive manner

Valid values: sensitive or insensitive

Default: sensitive

params.name: sort
params.description: The name of the field where the sort occurs

params.name: order
params.description:
The sort order preference

Valid values: ascending or descending

Default: descending

info.name: Removes the external store as a backup destination for the cluster. Backups remain on the external store, but they can no longer be managed by HPE SimpliVity.

items.docs: Removes the external store as a backup destination for the cluster. Backups remain on the external store, but they can no longer be managed by HPE SimpliVity.
